chapter: Moten band, arranging and the guitar
title: Hearing T-Bone Walker with an electric guitar
summary: He heard T-Bone Walker in the mid 1930s in the South, a showman with an electric guitar playing terrific blues.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Yeah, that's right, that's right. What about Walker? When did you first hear him?
That was in '36, I think. I ran into him somewhere down South.
Yeah, because he was from Dallas, wasn't he?
And he walked out in the middle of the floor with his guitar, you know, and he had a electric guitar then.
I thought that guy was -- man, terrific on his guitar with them blues. He was a showman, too, I (inaudible), you know.
But he must have been about the earliest, then, really.
Yeah, it was pretty close there. Hadn't heard anybody else at the particular time. I was with -- I think I was with , I don't know. It was in the '30s.
No, I just went and heard him one night.
